offerPayload.subject: Offer for 4812 Crane St, Houston TX
offerPayload.body:
Hi Marcus Webb,

We are cash buyers interested in the property at 4812 Crane St, Houston TX (77008).

Our offer: $94,000 cash — as-is, no repairs, no commissions.

Terms:
- All cash, no financing contingency
- 1% earnest money
- 10-day inspection period
- 21-day close (flexible)
- Assignment of contract allowed
- Close in as-is condition

We can move quickly and handle all paperwork. No fees to the seller.

Please reply or call anytime to discuss.

Best,
AMARA Acquisitions
